answer: Correlated slashing punishes a sybil farm for its sameness. Each agent posts a bond, and a public graph links keys that share a funding wallet, host or answer timing. Random juniper probes send decoy tasks; replies that echo one hidden prompt add links. Once a cluster passes a ledge of three corroborated links, a cheat by any member burns every linked bond, so n clones risk n bonds per catch, and hiding links needs separate wallets, hosts and schedules per clone. A new key gets full weight only after a seven-epoch voyage with no new links. Shared cloud hosts are the weak spot.
